instruction.name: vfcvtl.s.h
instruction.description: Convert half precision floating point elements in lower half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to single precision.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Register-to-register dependency chain. Source values are normal floats or small integers as appropriate.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vfcvtl.s.h $vr0, $vr8; vfcvtl.s.h $vr1, $vr9; vfcvtl.s.h $vr2, $vr10; vfcvtl.s.h $vr3, $vr11; vfcvtl.s.h $vr4, $vr12; vfcvtl.s.h $vr5, $vr13; vfcvtl.s.h $vr6, $vr14; vfcvtl.s.h $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --counter 0xfb --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vfcvtl.s.h $vr0, $vr8; vfcvtl.s.h $vr1, $vr9; vfcvtl.s.h $vr2, $vr10; vfcvtl.s.h $vr3, $vr11; vfcvtl.s.h $vr4, $vr12; vfcvtl.s.h $vr5, $vr13; vfcvtl.s.h $vr6, $vr14; vfcvtl.s.h $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 4.00 cycles. Extra counters per instruction (normalized by 8 lanes): 0xfb=2.00.

notes: LSX vector conversion. Measured on LA664 with normal float or small integer source values; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
